name: detect_services

region.description: AWS region to scan (default: server region)

name: generate_html_report
description: Generate a professional HTML security report. Save the output as an .html file.

scan_results.description: JSON string of FullScanResult from scan_all

history.description: JSON string of DashboardHistoryEntry[] from dashboard data.json for 30-day trend charts

ai_summary.description: Optional pre-generated AI executive summary (Markdown/plain text). Rendered if present; omit to hide.

ai_summary.description: Optional pre-generated AI executive summary (Markdown/plain text). Rendered if present; omit to hide.

history.description: JSON string of DashboardHistoryEntry[] from dashboard data.json for 30-day trend charts

ai_summary.description: Optional pre-generated AI executive summary (Markdown/plain text). Rendered if present; omit to hide.

scan_results.description: JSON string of FullScanResult from scan_group mlps3_precheck or scan_all

ai_summary.description: Optional pre-generated AI executive summary (Markdown/plain text). Rendered if present; omit to hide.

name: generate_report
description: Generate a Markdown security report from scan results. Read-only. Does not modify any AWS resources.

scan_results.description: JSON string of FullScanResult from scan_all

ai_summary.description: Optional pre-generated AI executive summary (Markdown/plain text). Rendered if present; omit to hide.

name: get_ai_summary_prompt
description: Return a report-type-tailored prompt (with a grounded findings digest) that the CALLING AI should run to produce an AI security summary. Then pass the generated text back via the `ai_summary` parameter of the matching report tool (or scan_and_report). The server performs no LLM calls. Use this to make each summary specific to the report type (dashboard / security scan / HW Defense 护网 / MLPS3 等保).

report_type.description: Target report type the summary is for: dashboard (overview), html (AWS security scan report), hw_defense (护网 attack-defense drill), mlps3 (等保三级 compliance)

scan_results.description: JSON string of FullScanResult from scan_all / scan_group

name: get_setup_template
description: Returns the CloudFormation StackSet template for deploying the cross-account security audit IAM role. Read-only.

format.description: Template format: yaml or json (default: yaml)

name: list_groups
description: List available scan groups with descriptions. Read-only.

name: list_modules
description: List available security scan modules with descriptions. Read-only. Does not modify any AWS resources.

name: list_org_accounts
description: List all accounts in the AWS Organization. Useful for discovering accounts before multi-account scanning. Read-only.

region.description: AWS region (default: server region)

name: save_results
description: Saves scan results to local disk or S3 for dashboard display. Does not modify any AWS resources.

scan_results.description: JSON string of FullScanResult from scan_all

ai_summary.description: Optional pre-generated AI executive summary (from get_ai_summary_prompt with report_type=dashboard). Persisted into dashboard data and rendered on the Overview; omit to hide.

region.description: AWS region to scan (default: server region)

name: scan_all
description: Run all security scanners in parallel (including service detection). Read-only. Does not modify any AWS resources. Supports multi-account org scanning.

region.description: AWS region to scan (default: server region)

org_mode.description: Enable multi-account scanning via AWS Organizations

role_name.description: IAM role name to assume in child accounts (default: AWSSecurityMCPAudit)

account_ids.description: Specific account IDs to scan (default: all org accounts)

name: scan_and_report
description: Run a full security scan AND generate reports in one step. Avoids large data transfer between tools. Reports are saved to ~/.aws-security/reports/

region.description: AWS region (default: server region)

role_name.description: IAM role name for cross-account scanning

ai_summary.description: Optional pre-generated AI executive summary (Markdown/plain text). Rendered in reports + dashboard if present; omit to hide.

name: scan_ecr_image_cve
description: Deep-scan ECR image layers for critical/high CVEs missed by ECR Basic/Inspector Enhanced scanning (unmanaged binaries, distro secdb gaps). Reports gap/confirmed/reverse-gap classification against official scan results. Read-only.

region.description: AWS region to scan (default: server region)

repository_filter.description: Glob filter on ECR repository names (e.g. prod-*)

max_images_per_repo.description: Latest-pushed N images per repo, plus any tag named 'latest' (default: 3)

min_severity.description: Minimum CVE severity to report (default: high)

online_cve_lookup.description: Enable NVD API 2.0 online lookup, cached 24h (default: false)

include_confirmed.description: Include confirmed finding detail rows in the report (default: false)

suppressions.description: False-positive suppression list; suppressed findings go to a suppressed[] section

max_layer_bytes.description: Skip images containing a layer larger than this many compressed bytes (default: 512 MB)

max_image_bytes.description: Skip images whose compressed layers total more than this many bytes (default: 2 GB)

max_binary_scan_bytes.description: Cap on decompressed bytes stream-scanned per candidate binary (default: 64 MB)

max_repositories.description: Maximum number of repositories to scan; the rest are recorded in warnings (default: 50)

max_total_bytes.description: Cumulative cap on compressed layer bytes downloaded across the whole scan (default: 20 GB)

platform_preference.description: Platform preference order for multi-arch manifest lists, e.g. ['linux/amd64', 'linux/arm64'] (default)

name: scan_group
description: Run a predefined group of security scanners for a specific scenario (e.g., MLPS compliance, network defense). Read-only. Supports multi-account org scanning.

group.description: Scan group ID: mlps3_precheck, hw_defense, exposure, data_encryption, least_privilege, log_integrity, disaster_recovery, idle_resources, tag_compliance, new_account_baseline, container_security, aggregation

region.description: AWS region to scan (default: server region)

org_mode.description: Enable multi-account scanning via AWS Organizations

role_name.description: IAM role name to assume in child accounts (default: AWSSecurityMCPAudit)

account_ids.description: Specific account IDs to scan (default: all org accounts)
